main_text.p: condendis docetur alibi: in rebus fidei autem sunt alligati Dei verbo. Deut. 17. 18. Ios. 1. 8. ac proinde neque veteres fidei articulos abrogare, neque novos condere possunt: Si qui hac in re exorbitaverint, satius est vel vitam ꝑfundere, ad exemplum s. martyrum, quàm in hominis gratiam veritatem in Dei verbo revelatam abnegare.

16. Confundi munia ecclesiastica et politica. Resp. Si ad s. scripturæ normæ & exemplū ecclesiæ veteris omnia instituantur, nulla confusio metuenda est. Nunc nobis sufficit demō- strase, pertinere ad officium magistratus politici etiam cognoscere & dijudicare religionis controversi- as. Ita Constantinus Magnus & patres vel doctores ecclesiæ Nicææ congregati, canones communi consensu promulgarunt : eodemque modo factitatum est in concilio Constantinopolitano, Ephesino, Chalcedonensi & aliis. 17 Imperatores christianos committisse iudicium rerum eccle-

page.notes: Catchword "siastica-" is the start of the next page's word "ecclesiastica", printed with a hyphen. "demō- strase," reads as printed; the second word is unclear, possibly "demonstrasse" with a misprint, so it is not corrected. The "17" in mid-paragraph is an inline number in the text, not a margin note. Italic runs are marked where they are visible. No running head is printed.
